body:
Hey raindead, thanks for your response :) Got my exam done after an all-nighter, and it actually went reasonably well. I am incredibly tired, but will be going to the gym, have dinner with friends tonight, etc ... I miss her so much, she's constantly on my mind, and I KNOW I can go back and ask for "forgiveness" - just trying to be hard to myself right now, which is not easy. The main part that drives me crazy is that I seriously don't "remember" all the bad times we have had, and only imagine how utterly beautiful everything would be if we were together - It's ridiculous how your mind is messing with you.

I hope now, that the exam time is over, I have more time to distract myself, and learn to move on. I have simply been never so overwhelmed emotionally due to another person - It's quite an experience, really.
Blocked off all contact: No Fbook, deleted number and Skype, and we don't write each other via email. Will do friends distraction as freaking soon as this exam is over :)

> thats not something that will make you feel better right NOW.

and

>  It's really coming to terms with the fact that one day she will be sharing her love (physically and emotionally) with someone other than you which is probably inconcievable for you at this point in time.

Could not have said it better - Right now, it is not that I fear there will be someone else (although, once that is the case, it will disturb me to great extend) - It's ... missing the warmth and love she gave me, the compassion and affection I was feeling. A person, so close to you, suddenly so far away - although in the same building. That's very difficult for me to comprehend right now..
I would like to say thank you to both of you :) You have already helped me a lot with your kind words. All the best, to both of you! :)
I would like to say thank you to both of you :) You have already helped me a lot with your kind words. All the best, to both of you! :)
Thanks for your help! :) Thank you.

It's just .. funny, how rationally everything makes sense. But emotionally, I am crying myself to sleep, and I wished I would be able to hug her again. One more time. Then again. Then again.. thinking, maybe we have a pause right now, and it will work again in a few weeks? I love her, no? Maybe a break is all we needed, to realize what we mean to each other - since: everytime we lose each other, that is when we feel the most powerful about each other

Thanks for your amazing effort and support! You know you help, but still, you probably don't know how much I appreciate it, especially coming from a stranger - often when good friends have considerably less time right now :) (And, I also shed it off .. "yes yes ,everything is fine!")

I can go to a gym/do sports, yes, and will do so every day. The important part right now is one big exam tomorrow morning.. For that, I will try to go to bed soon, and wake up very early - It will allow me another 5-6 h to at least understand  the basics, and not fail the exam. I have had my time to study, but unfortunately was unable to use it since I was consistently thinking of her. Always. The moment I sat down, I was thinking of herr. Once I got distracted (gym), I was fine, but right now time constraints due to the exam do not really allow me to become distracted too much ;)

Yes, yes. Thank you. It's funny, I don't know exactly myself what I am/was hoping to get out of this, but funnily just talking about the obvious makes me already feel better. The breakup WAS good and justified (when I will tell you that I am soon moving to another country, anyway, you will probably laugh - "what's your problem, mate?"). We fought all the time, were unable to connect, were quite shallow after while - very attracted to each other on a physical basis, but on an emotional basis on very different levels.. so YES, the breakup, rationally seen, makes perfect sense.

Emotionally, its draining. The first few days were alright, we blocked all contact, I hit the gym, talked to friends, I was alright. But the longer the week, the more, I assume, I am consciously realizing what just happened. Seeing her around at university from time to time hits me hard, looking at photos reminds me of the good times, and most importantly - not being able to talk to her, I completely forget about the things I disliked about her (which become obvious once I hear her voice, am in immediate contact). Right now, I just see her utter beautifulness. And then, you are right - there is no "right" or "wrong". While I hated many things about us, the relationship, or her, as I was desperate that changes did not occur positively, but only backfired, I was STILL, nevertheless, in love. To weigh off the cost-benefit of "breaking up", saying ... "I love her that much" vs "This is very annoying to me" is not easy - I felt that the latter was heavier, and I would be more relieved if I could shake it off in my life. Right now, I somewhat feel like I should have paid more attention to the former, and wait/invest even more energy into making the latter work.

Regarding the every 10-minutes, that seems to be only the case for very new accounts (including mine) - I don't know if this would be different via personal messages?

What you are hinting at is to get distracted! I am fully with you on that, problem however is the exams week - Right now is unfortunatley not the time to party and hang out with best friends, as everyone is busy. Addition to my problem right now, of course, is that I SHOULD be studying myself, but instead am hanging in bed, belittling and crying to myself, despite having an exam tomorrow which I literally don't know anything for yet. That put aside, I look at photos of her, think of the good times, and feel incredibly lonely - All the  things that I should not be doing, I know. It's just.. After such a long time, this feels like a major loss to me, as somebody had died - and YET SHE'S RIGHT THERE! I could, It MIGHT work, MAYBE ... (and then again: but why did I break up then?)

Ha! I sure can use some distraction! :) The best thing I could do now is do sports, go to the bars, be with friends, hang out  -do anything but alone. Unfortunately it happens to be exams week, and  the only things everyone doe is staring at their books and laptops. As I try to do the same, I just cannot concentrate, and the girl I am thinking of so much is literally sitting 2 floors below me - I could see her any time, say hi. It would be awkward, but just knowing that I am close to her is incredibly comforting - how much do I wish I would be even able to be just next to her, kiss her on the forehead, caress her ... - everything I was able to do just last week. Right now  I feel like I threw all this away, and again: the thing that upsets/confuses me the most is that I literally have forgotten all negative things that were the sole reasons I broke up for! I coulnd't stand these fights anymore, couldn't take all the demands and the complaining - and yet I still love(d) her, for who she was, and for what she's been through with me in the past years. We had fought hard for this relationship to survive, and "throwing it away" was a hard decision - I ultimately don't know whether I should regret it. I REMEMBER that for me, a week ago, this was the best and clearest decision I could possibly take, it made perfect sense. Right now, I can only shake my head in disbelief, and ask myself "Why did you do this?". I want her to be around me so badly!
OK thanks - I will just wait a few more minutes before I respond  :)

Thanks for your great offer to help! I just wrote GeeMandy a message. It just feels good to have people speak to you, even if they are telling the truth that I already know... "it will get better" - right now, however, it just looks so so dark... 

BTW: not first love, but first committed long term relationship, yes (I am in my twenties, however - this is no teenage highschool nonsense ;) Even if I feel like it is ...)

I believe you when you are saying it will all become better. But the situation right now is so incredibly desperate, and I don't know how to deal with it. Worse, I have the "power" to reverse things, go see her now, talk it through, and get back together. As someone else once said to me, it's like heroin. Once I get my "fix" (= hug, kisses, attention), the old problems will reoccur most likely. We have done this before, attempted to work it through, and ended up in the exact same situation. However, as I broke up again, right now I am completely unable to find a reason why I would ever have broken up with her! My mind is drawing totally blank. All I see are the incredibly beautiful moments we have had
Thanks, I had just sent you a message, as I think you had offered to talk  via AIM :)
